description: A whole book of the Bible at a glance: who wrote it and when (where faithful Christians differ, each view with its grounds, given as references and the Church Fathers' own words), how the book is laid out in movements, its key verse, the Hebrew or Greek words it turns on (Strong's numbers), its themes, how it points to Christ, its links to other books, what the Fathers said of it, and its main people and places. CALL THIS FIRST for a question about a whole book — who wrote it, when, to whom, how it is built, what it is about, how to read it — then go deeper with the verse and word tools. It covers the 66 books of the Protestant canon. The result's `url` is the book's study page on trulyrandomverse.com; to send the reader there, link that address.

book.description: The book's English name, e.g. "Ruth", "1 Corinthians", "Song of Solomon".
